import cv2,numpy as np
im=cv2.imread('first_frame.png')[:,:,::-1]

# HSV using RGB->HSV manually through cv2 BGR
hsv=cv2.cvtColor(im[:,:,::-1],cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
R,G,B=im.transpose(2,0,1)
classes=np.full((h,w),' ',dtype='<U1')

classes[(B>R*1.15)&(B>G*1.05)]='b'

# downsample nearest every 10x10 using majority-ish choose center
for y in range(0,h,10):
 print(''.join(classes[y,x] for x in range(0,w,10)))
